mapper.select: SELECT id, spot_id, display_order, photo_url FROM spot_photos WHERE spot_id = #{spotId} ORDER BY display_order
SELECT id, spot_id, display_order, photo_url FROM spot_photos WHERE spot_id = #{spotId} AND display_order = #{displayOrder} LIMIT 1
SELECT id, spot_id, display_order, photo_url FROM spot_photos WHERE spot_id = #{spotId} AND display_order >= #{displayOrder} ORDER BY display_order ASC
SELECT id, spot_id, display_order, photo_url FROM spot_photos WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO spot_photos (spot_id, display_order, photo_url) VALUES (#{spotId}, #{displayOrder}, #{photoUrl})
